title: Great tour!
text: Really informative and excellent tour! We learned everything about the history of the Jewish history of Seville!
author: William_R

title: Jewish Quarter Walking Tour
text: My husband and I spent the most delightful 2 hours walking the Jewish Quarter with Alba Delgado. She shared the chronological history of the area as we toured, explaining significant sites along the way, as well as her personal research on the topic. Her passion and ease of telling the story of the Jewish people in Seville was enjoyable and informative. We highly recommend this tour with Alba!
author: LoriS424

title: Fabulous Tour with Alba
text: Alba was sensational! We were a little late arriving because of a flight delay but she wasn’t bothered by that. She was bright, energetic and very passionate about Jewish history in Seville, as that has been the focus of her studies. She is absolutely delightful and we highly recommend her for any tour.

title: Fantastic!

title: Visiting Sevilla
text: Alba was one of the most amazing tour guide I've encountered. She is very passionate about her work which makes the interraction and the visit even more interesting. author: 323julietf

title: So much to learn from Alba!!
text:
We really enjoyed our tour with Alba last month (January 2026)!  Alba is a wealth of knowledge; she is witty; she is vibrant; and she adds just the right flair of drama to emphasize certain points:  So effective!!

We had only a limited amount of time in Seville, so we were grateful that Alba was able to combine (at our request) her Jewish Heritage Tour of Seville with a tour of the Seville Cathedral and Real Alcázar.  Given the very sparse physical remnants of Jewish life in Seville these days, it was remarkable how Alba was able to conjure for us a feel for that aspect of Seville's history;
author: pln1961

title: Amazing insights into the Jewish history of Sevilla
text: This tour is amazing. Alba has invested so much research and shares with you a history that, quite simply, no other tour guide can offer. She has a passion that shines through. If you are considering a tour of the Jewish Quarter in Sevilla, you must arrange to have Alba as your guide.
